summary: Student-first machine candidate for Seoul National University AI Guidelines and Library guidance. Korean-source claims are summarized in English without a translation record; teaching, research, library, and service scopes remain separate.

dimensions.summary: SNU requires instructors to communicate permitted or prohibited scope and reporting methods through syllabi. Scope: course-level instructor communication.

do: Read the syllabus for the course-specific AI rule.
dont: Do not infer a course rule from a general SNU service listing.

dimensions.summary: No source-backed SNU student exam rule is included; this is not evidence of permission or prohibition.
SNU guidance requires transparent AI-use disclosure and cited research guidance requires authors to state which tools were used and how. Scope: SNU guidance and Library-reproduced research guidance.

do: Disclose the AI tool and use in the format required by the applicable guidance.
dont: Do not omit AI-use disclosure from work covered by the cited rule.

dimensions.summary: SNU guidance emphasizes protection of research data and warns that uploading subscribed e-resources to third-party AI may exceed license terms. Scope: research and Library guidance.

do: Check data and subscription terms before uploading material.
dont: Do not upload protected research or subscribed resources to an unapproved AI service.

dimensions.summary: A public SNU source lists ChatGPT Edu as an official tool record. The listing is separate from course, assessment, data, or research permission.

do: Verify eligibility and the course or project rule before use.
dont: Do not infer academic permission from the listed service.

dimensions.summary: SNU research guidance requires output checking, data protection, reproducibility documentation, and disclosure of AI tools and use. Scope: SNU research and Library guidance.

do: Document and verify AI use in the research process.
dont: Do not list AI as an author or conceal how it contributed.

limitations: This tracker is not legal advice, not academic integrity advice, and not an official university statement unless a linked source is the university's own official page.
This is a machine-candidate snapshot, not a student conclusion; overallStatus remains needs_review pending independent secondary review.
Scope follows the cited source role and unit. A faculty, school, department, course, assessment, library, or staff rule is not generalized university-wide.
English is canonical. Source evidence may be multilingual; no translation is provided or independently reviewed in this candidate.
A university-provided, licensed, or listed tool is not by itself permission to use it in a course, assessment, thesis, or research project.
